task.question: How many times more developing young did honeybee colonies produce when fed a synthetic biology supplement, as reported on 27 March 2026?
task.evidence: Researchers led by the University of Oxford report a synthetic biology approach to improving honeybee nutrition, engineering yeast to produce essential sterols missing from modern diets. Colonies fed the supplement produce up to 15 times more developing young.

answer:
Honeybee colonies fed a synthetic biology supplement produced up to 15 times more developing young, as reported on 27 March 2026. 

FINAL: 15 times more.
